Each party remains responsible for obligations accrued before termination. Fees paid for post-effective-date periods are credited against other amounts due, and any remaining credit is refunded within 60 days.

source_contract_text: 8.1 Expiration and Renewal. The initial term expires on June 30, 2028. The Agreement renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of nonrenewal at least one hundred twenty (120) days before the end of the then-current term. 8.2 Breach Termination. Either party may terminate for a material breach by the other party that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice. If the breach is not reasonably capable of cure within thirty days, the breaching party must begin cure within that period and diligently complete it within a further thirty days; termination may occur if it fails to do so. 8.3 Immediate Termination. Licensor may terminate immediately by written notice if Distributor knowingly sublicenses the rights without consent or uses the licensed technology outside the Territory after receiving written notice of the unauthorized use. 8.4 Transition and Stock. Upon expiration or termination, all licensed rights cease and Distributor must stop accepting orders for licensed products. For sixty (60) days after the effective date, Distributor may fulfill orders accepted before that date from finished goods on hand, but may not solicit new orders or produce additional units. Within fifteen (15) days after that period, Distributor must provide an inventory statement. Licensor may, within thirty (30) days after receiving the statement, elect to purchase remaining finished goods at the lower of Distributor's documented landed cost or the current wholesale price; any goods not purchased must be destroyed within ten (10) days after the election period, and Distributor must certify destruction. 8.5 Final Accounting. Distributor must deliver a final sales and royalty report within thirty (30) days after the effective date and pay all royalties and other undisputed sums within forty-five (45) days after that date. Each party remains responsible for obligations accrued before termination. Fees paid for periods after the effective date are credited against other amounts due, with any remaining credit refunded within sixty (60) days. 8.6 Continuing Terms. Confidentiality, ownership, accrued payment obligations, audit rights for records relating to the term, and the limitations of liability survive. Distributor must promptly return Licensor's technical materials and cease use of its marks, except as strictly necessary to fulfill permitted pre-termination orders.
inventory_disposition: For 60 days after expiration or termination, Distributor may fulfill orders accepted before the effective date from finished goods on hand, but may not solicit new orders or make additional units. It must provide an inventory statement within 15 days after that period. Licensor may elect within 30 days after receiving the statement to purchase remaining finished goods at the lower of documented landed cost or current wholesale price. Goods not purchased must be destroyed within 10 days after the election period, with certification.
surviving_obligations: Confidentiality, ownership, accrued payment obligations, audit rights for records relating to the term, and limitations of liability survive. Distributor must return Licensor's technical materials and cease mark use, subject to the narrow use necessary to fulfill permitted pre-termination orders.
termination_mechanism: Fixed-term expiration with automatic successive one-year renewals unless timely nonrenewal notice is given; termination for uncured material breach; and immediate termination by Licensor for specified conduct.
termination_right_holder: Either party may give nonrenewal notice or terminate for an uncured material breach. Only Licensor may exercise the immediate termination right described in Section 8.3.
exceptions_and_conditions: The additional cure period applies only when a breach is not reasonably capable of cure within the initial 30 days, and the breaching party must begin and diligently pursue cure. The 60-day fulfillment right applies only to orders accepted before the effective date and finished goods already on hand. Licensor's purchase option is limited to remaining finished goods and is subject to the stated price formula and election deadline.
termination_trigger_summary: The agreement expires at the end of its stated term unless renewed, and either party can prevent renewal by timely nonrenewal notice. Either party may terminate for an uncured material breach. Licensor has an immediate termination right for knowing unauthorized sublicensing or out-of-Territory technology use after written notice.
notice_and_cure_requirements: Nonrenewal requires written notice at least 120 days before the end of the current term. Material breach requires written notice and a 30-day cure period; if cure cannot reasonably be completed within 30 days, the breaching party must begin curing within that period and diligently complete within an additional 30 days. Immediate termination for unauthorized sublicensing or out-of-Territory use is by Licensor's written notice; for the latter, prior written notice of the unauthorized use is also specified.
termination_effective_timing: The agreement expires June 30, 2028, unless renewed, and thereafter at the end of each renewed one-year term unless timely nonrenewal notice is given. Breach termination follows failure to cure within the applicable 30-day period, including any additional diligent-cure period of up to 30 days where applicable. The specified Section 8.3 termination may be immediate by written notice.
post_termination_restrictions: Distributor must stop accepting orders for licensed products, may not solicit new orders or produce additional units during the 60-day fulfillment period, and must cease using the marks and return technical materials. Limited mark use is allowed only as strictly necessary to fulfill permitted pre-termination orders.
license_rights_after_termination: All licensed rights cease upon expiration or termination. The only stated limited continuation is the 60-day right to fulfill orders accepted before the effective date using finished goods on hand; no new orders may be solicited and no additional units may be produced.

exceptions_and_conditions: The insolvency termination right does not apply to a solvent reorganization. The 120-day sell-off right is available only when termination is not for Distributor's breach and is conditional on timely payment and continued compliance with brand-use and reporting provisions. Licensor may elect repurchase instead; the excerpt does not state a separate deadline for exercising that election.
payment_settlement: Royalties and other amounts accrued through the effective date remain payable within 30 days after termination. Prepaid minimum royalties are nonrefundable. The stated inventory repurchase price, if Licensor elects repurchase, is documented net acquisition cost.
supporting_evidence: Section 12.1: either party may terminate for material breach not cured within 30 days after detailed written notice; undisputed payment failures have a 10-day cure period. Section 12.2: either party may terminate on 90 days' written notice. Section 12.3: immediate written termination for specified insolvency events, except solvent reorganization. Section 12.4: conditional 120-day sell-off, optional repurchase, and destruction of remaining inventory. Sections 12.5–12.6: accrued amounts, survival, and limited mark use.
source_contract_text: 12.1 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within thirty (30) days after receiving notice describing the breach in reasonable detail. A failure to pay an undisputed amount is subject to a ten (10) day cure period after written notice. 12.2 Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason on ninety (90) days' written notice. 12.3 Insolvency. Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or enters liquidation, except for a solvent reorganization. 12.4 Effect; Inventory. On termination, Distributor's license ends, except that if termination is not for Distributor's breach, Distributor may sell its then-current, conforming inventory for up to one hundred twenty (120) days, provided it pays all amounts when due and continues to comply with the brand-use and reporting provisions. No new inventory may be manufactured during the sell-off period. At Licensor's election, Licensor may instead repurchase unopened, saleable inventory at Distributor's documented net acquisition cost; any inventory not sold or repurchased must be destroyed, with written certification. 12.5 Accrued Amounts and Survival. All royalties and other amounts accrued through the effective date remain payable within thirty (30) days after termination. No prepaid minimum royalty is refundable. Each party shall return or destroy the other party's confidential information upon request, subject to one archival copy retained solely for legal compliance. Sections concerning accrued payment obligations, confidentiality, indemnification, audit records, and dispute resolution survive. 12.6 Limited Use. During an authorized sell-off, Distributor may use the licensed marks solely to advertise and sell conforming inventory in the Territory and may not suggest that it remains an authorized distributor.
inventory_disposition: If termination is not for Distributor's breach, Distributor may sell existing conforming inventory for up to 120 days, subject to timely payment and continued compliance with brand-use and reporting provisions; it may not manufacture new inventory. Licensor may elect to repurchase unopened, saleable inventory at documented net acquisition cost. Remaining inventory must be destroyed with written certification if neither sold nor repurchased.
surviving_obligations: Accrued payment obligations, confidentiality, indemnification, audit records, and dispute resolution survive. Each party must return or destroy the other party's confidential information upon request, subject to retention of one archival copy solely for legal compliance.
termination_mechanism: Termination for cause after a cure period; termination for convenience on 90 days' notice; or immediate termination by notice for specified insolvency events.
termination_right_holder: Either party may exercise the material-breach, convenience, and insolvency termination rights.
termination_trigger_summary: Termination is permitted for an uncured material breach, including a specifically shorter cure period for undisputed nonpayment; either party may also terminate for convenience on notice or terminate immediately upon specified insolvency events, subject to the solvent-reorganization exception.
notice_and_cure_requirements: Material breach requires written notice describing the breach in reasonable detail and a 30-day opportunity to cure. An undisputed payment default has a 10-day cure period after written notice. Convenience termination requires 90 days' written notice. Insolvency termination is by written notice and has no stated cure period.
termination_effective_timing: For uncured material breach, termination may follow expiration of the applicable 30-day cure period, or 10-day period for undisputed nonpayment. Convenience termination takes effect after the 90-day notice period. Insolvency termination may take effect immediately upon written notice.
post_termination_restrictions: Distributor may not manufacture new inventory during the sell-off period, may use the marks only to advertise and sell conforming inventory in the Territory, and may not imply that it remains an authorized distributor. Confidential information must be returned or destroyed upon request, subject to the stated archival-copy exception.
license_rights_after_termination: The license ends upon termination, except for the limited authorization to advertise and sell conforming inventory during an eligible sell-off period. That authorization is limited to the Territory and does not permit Distributor to represent itself as still authorized.

payment_settlement: Royalties on pre-termination sales and sales during an authorized sell-off remain payable on the ordinary reporting schedule. Other undisputed accrued amounts are due within 30 days. Minimum guarantees are nonrefundable. Sales and royalty records must be retained for three years, with a final audit permitted on reasonable notice during that period.

Section 15.2: cessation of rights, conditional 90-day sell-off, optional repurchase, and destruction. Section 15.3: royalty and payment settlement, nonrefundability, record retention, and audit. source_contract_text: 15.1 Termination Rights. Licensee may terminate this Agreement on written notice if Licensor fails to deliver the approved product artwork within sixty (60) days after the agreed delivery date and does not cure that failure within fifteen (15) days after receiving Licensee's notice. Licensee may also terminate if net sales fall below the annual minimum in Schedule B for two consecutive contract years, but only after giving Licensor thirty (30) days to verify the sales calculation and provide any documented adjustment. Licensor may terminate immediately by written notice if Licensee grants an unauthorized sublicense or knowingly removes a required product-origin notice. Either party may terminate for another material breach not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice. 15.2 Effects. On the effective date, Licensee's rights to manufacture, advertise, distribute, and sell the licensed products cease, except for the sell-off right in this Section. If termination is not based on Licensee's breach, Licensee may sell finished, compliant stock for ninety (90) days, provided all royalties are current and monthly sales reports are delivered. If termination is based on Licensee's breach, Licensor may, at its option, repurchase compliant finished stock at Licensee's documented manufacturing cost; Licensee must hold the stock pending Licensor's election for twenty (20) days after termination. Any stock not eligible for sell-off or repurchase must be destroyed within thirty (30) days, with a written certificate. 15.3 Settlement and Records. Royalties on sales made before termination and during an authorized sell-off remain payable under the ordinary reporting schedule. All other undisputed amounts accrued before termination are due within thirty (30) days. No minimum guarantee is refunded. Licensee must retain sales and royalty records for three (3) years and permit a final audit on reasonable notice during that period. 15.4 Continuing Duties. Confidentiality, payment and audit obligations, indemnities for claims arising from pre-termination conduct, and provisions governing ownership of intellectual property survive. After rights cease, Licensee must stop using Licensor's name, marks, and product artwork, remove them from promotional materials within ten (10) business days, and return or destroy confidential materials. Nothing in this Section restricts Licensee from retaining records required by law, subject to continuing confidentiality obligations.
inventory_disposition: If termination is not based on Licensee's breach, Licensee may sell finished, compliant stock for 90 days if royalties are current and monthly reports are delivered. If termination is based on Licensee's breach, Licensor may elect to repurchase compliant finished stock at documented manufacturing cost; Licensee must hold it for 20 days pending the election. Other stock not eligible for sell-off or repurchase must be destroyed within 30 days, with written certification.
surviving_obligations: Confidentiality, payment and audit obligations, indemnities for claims arising from pre-termination conduct, and intellectual-property ownership provisions survive. Licensee must return or destroy confidential materials, but may retain records required by law subject to continuing confidentiality obligations.
termination_mechanism: Termination for cause with trigger-specific procedures: Licensee's delayed-delivery and minimum-sales rights, Licensor's immediate rights for specified conduct, and a mutual material-breach termination right.
termination_right_holder: Licensee may exercise the delayed-artwork, consecutive-year minimum-sales, and general material-breach rights. Licensor may exercise the immediate rights for unauthorized sublicensing or knowing removal of a required product-origin notice, and the general material-breach right is available to either party.
exceptions_and_conditions: The minimum-sales termination right is subject to a 30-day verification and documented-adjustment process. The 90-day sell-off is available only if termination is not based on Licensee's breach and royalties are current with monthly reporting. If termination is based on Licensee's breach, repurchase is an option for Licensor, not an automatic obligation, and applies to compliant finished stock. Legally required records may be retained subject to confidentiality.
termination_trigger_summary: Licensee may terminate for delayed delivery of approved artwork after notice and an uncured 15-day period, or for two consecutive years below the annual minimum sales threshold after a verification opportunity. Licensor may terminate immediately for unauthorized sublicensing or knowing removal of a required origin notice. Either party may terminate for another uncured material breach.
notice_and_cure_requirements: For delayed artwork, Licensee must give written notice and allow 15 days to cure after the 60-day delivery-delay threshold. For the minimum-sales trigger, Licensee must allow Licensor 30 days to verify the calculation and provide a documented adjustment. General material breach requires written notice and a 30-day cure period. Licensor's specified conduct-based termination is immediate by written notice, with no cure period stated.
termination_effective_timing: Delayed-artwork termination is available after artwork is more than 60 days late and remains undelivered 15 days after Licensee's written notice. Minimum-sales termination is available after two consecutive contract years below the threshold and the 30-day verification period. General breach termination follows an uncured 30-day notice period. Licensor's specified conduct-based termination may take effect immediately by written notice.
post_termination_restrictions: Once rights cease, Licensee must stop using Licensor's name, marks, and product artwork and remove them from promotional materials within 10 business days. Confidential materials must be returned or destroyed, except that records required by law may be retained under continuing confidentiality obligations. The authorized sell-off is limited to qualifying finished, compliant stock and is subject to royalty and reporting conditions.
license_rights_after_termination: Manufacturing, advertising, distribution, and sales rights cease on the effective date, subject to the conditional 90-day sell-off authorization for qualifying finished stock when termination is not based on Licensee's breach.
